Trailer: ‘All the Good Eyes’

By Phil MillsApr 8, 2026

‘All the Good Eyes’ (森中有林) is a 2026 Chinese crime drama written and directed by Zheng Zhi.

Synopsis: After losing an eye in a violent incident, a dismissed prison guard unexpectedly introduces his daughter to the man responsible, believing the sacrifice might secure her future. Years later, his past resurfaces and entangles two families across three generations.
